title: Mechanisms of fever-induced QT prolongation and torsades de pointes in patients with KCNH2 mutation.
authors: Usuda, Keisuke; Hayashi, Kenshi; Nakajima, Tadashi; Kurata, Yasutaka; Cui, Shihe; Kusayama, Takashi; Tsuda, Toyonobu; Tada, Hayato; Kato, Takeshi; Sakata, Kenji; Usui, Soichiro; Fujino, Noboru; Tanaka, Yoshihiro; Kaneko, Yoshiaki; Kurabayashi, Masahiko; Tange, Shoichi; Saito, Takekatsu; Ohta, Kunio; Yamagishi, Masakazu; Takamura, Masayuki
journal: Europace : European pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac electrophysiology : journal of the working groups on cardiac pacing, arrhythmias, and cardiac cellular electrophysiology of the European Society of Cardiology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究KCNH2突变导致发热诱导QT延长和尖端扭转型室速的电生理机制，属于心脏离子通道病临床与电生理研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: Patients with particular mutations of type-2 long QT syndrome (LQT2) are at an increased risk for malignant arrhythmia during fever. This study aimed to determine the mechanism by which KCNH2 mutations cause fever-induced QT prolongation and torsades de pointes (TdP). METHODS AND RESULTS: We evaluated three KCNH2 mutations, G584S, D609G, and T613M, in the Kv11.1 S5-pore region, identified in patients with marked QT prolongation and TdP during fever. We also evaluated KCNH2 M124T and R269W, which are not associated with fever-induced QT prolongation. We characterized the temperature-dependent changes in the electrophysiological properties of the mutant Kv11.1 channels by patch-clamp recording and computer simulation. The average tail current densities (TCDs) at 35 degrees C for G584S, WT+D609G, and WT+T613M were significantly smaller and less increased with rising temperature from 35 degrees C to 40 degrees C than those for WT, M124T, and R269W. The ratios of the TCDs at 40 degrees C to 35 degrees C for G584S, WT+D609G, and WT+T613M were significantly smaller than for WT, M124T, and R269W. The voltage dependence of the steady-state inactivation curve for WT, M124T, and R269W showed a significant positive shift with increasing temperature; however, that for G584S, WT+D609G, and WT+T613M showed no significant change. Computer simulation demonstrated that G584S, WT+D609G, and WT+T613M caused prolonged action potential durations and early afterdepolarization formation at 40 degrees C. CONCLUSION: These findings indicate that KCNH2 G584S, D609G, and T613M in the S5-pore region reduce the temperature-dependent increase in TCDs through an enhanced inactivation, resulting in QT prolongation and TdP at a febrile state in patients with LQT2.
abstract_zh: 目的：携带特定2型长QT综合征（LQT2）突变的患者在发热期间发生恶性心律失常的风险增加。本研究旨在确定KCNH2突变导致发热诱导的QT延长和尖端扭转型室性心动过速（TdP）的机制。方法与结果：我们评估了位于Kv11.1 S5-孔区域的三个KCNH2突变（G584S、D609G和T613M），这些突变在发热期间出现显著QT延长和TdP的患者中被识别。我们还评估了与发热诱导的QT延长无关的KCNH2 M124T和R269W。我们通过膜片钳记录和计算机模拟表征了突变Kv11.1通道电生理特性的温度依赖性变化。在35°C时，G584S、WT+D609G和WT+T613M的平均尾电流密度（TCDs）显著小于WT、M124T和R269W，并且随着温度从35°C升至40°C，其增加幅度也显著较小。G584S、WT+D609G和WT+T613M在40°C与35°C时的TCD比值显著小于WT、M124T和R269W。WT、M124T和R269W的稳态失活曲线电压依赖性随温度升高显示出显著的正向移位；然而，G584S、WT+D609G和WT+T613M的曲线没有显著变化。计算机模拟表明，G584S、WT+D609G和WT+T613M在40°C时导致动作电位时程延长和早期后除极形成。结论：这些发现表明，S5-孔区域的KCNH2 G584S、D609G和T613M通过增强失活减少了温度依赖性TCD增加，从而导致LQT2患者在发热状态下出现QT延长和TdP。
